en: Fixed a saved Claude apps gateway sign-in being ignored on machines whose managed settings set `forceLoginMethod` to `gateway` with no `forceLoginGatewayUrl` (regression in 2.1.295)
zh: 修复在托管设置将 `forceLoginMethod` 设为 `gateway` 且未设置 `forceLoginGatewayUrl` 的机器上，已保存的 Claude 应用网关登录被忽略的问题（2.1.295 引入的回归）
